programmes.d: After 10 kilograms of highly toxic chemical weapons go missing, Gibbs and his team scramble to locate it. The NCIS team is horrified when they discover that the deadly chemical weapon is now held by wanted terrorist Mamoun Sharif.

After capturing one international arms dealer, the NCIS team discovers that the Navy's highly classified weapons system is about to be sold to another high priority arms dealer known as "La Grenouille" (Armand Assante).
Working with the local officials, the NCIS team originally believes a the sailor died of an unintentional drug overdose in a seedy part of town.
Victoria's lady-loving thespian father and Melanie's worrywart mother both visit the house, and Elka becomes buddies with Joy's critical mother via video chat.
The women crash a Rock & Roll Hall of Fame party, where Melanie awkwardly meets her idol, and Victoria seeks revenge on her former bad boy flame Johnny Revere.
Victoria is offered a Japanese commercial for an embarrassing product, and Melanie worries that local columnist Rick will write an unflattering piece about her.
While Victoria and Joy try to dissuade Melanie from getting back together with her ex-husband, Elka is caught in a love triangle between Max and Nick.
Joy feels abandoned by Melanie, who is focusing on her new boyfriend Pete, and a theatrical teenager asks Victoria to advise his high school production of Shakespeare.
Victoria fakes having a disfiguring illness to improve her chances of winning a Daytime Emmy, and Melanie tries to reconnect with her college-age son Will.
During a dangerous storm, Victoria is unable to fly to the Daytime Emmys, Joy is contacted by the son she put up for adoption, and Melanie blurts out a confession to Pete.
Elka has a familiar jail cellmate, Victoria's assets are frozen, Joy desperately needs Rick's help, and Melanie is irate with Pete for busting her friends.
Sabrina learns about the responsibilities that come with using magic when she earns her witch’s learner’s permit.
Sabrina takes advantage of Vice Principal Kraft’s attraction to Aunt Hilda.
Sabrina learns not to date outside of her realm after a bad evening with a witch boy.
Babysitting becomes a test of ingenuity when Sabrina’s bratty little cousin turns her into a doll.
The mysteries of men are revealed when Sabrina poses as a boy to figure out how they think.
Halloween is a scary night indeed when Sabrina and her aunts try to throw a normal party

Attorney Perry Mason's attractive client claims she was chased by a hooded man in a car. Now she's wanted for his murder...and hasn't been too honest about her past arrest as a jewel thief. Now Streaming on Paramount+
When his stepbrother is found dead, a man is charged with murder and is accused of using his sleepwalking as a cover-up. Now Streaming on Paramount+
A wealthy woman hires Mason to buy stock in her husband's land company, hoping to force his mistress out. But her plan goes awry when she is charged with murder. Now Streaming on Paramount+
Perry Mason, Della Street, and Paul Drake head to a small town to defend a young man who is charged with poisoning a blackmailer. Now Streaming on Paramount+

An impetuous niece who demands her trust fund be released comes to Perry Mason for help. But it's her boyfriend who needs defending when he is charged with murdering her controlling uncle. Now Streaming on Paramount+

Operating with daring, and virtually under the nose of Five-O Chief Steve McGarrett, Hawaiian history museum curator Arthur Lambert secretly plots to turn criminal and stage the biggest bank robbery in Island annals.

Honolulu prostitutes are being murdered, and those who have not been are living in terror. McGarrett feels sure the murderer's game is extortion — a demand accompanied by a death threat which is carried out if the demand is not met.
Five bodies found in Mauna Loa volcano crater due to radioactive poisoning from plutonium exposure. Steve McGarrett investigates to find source on the Island.

Tragedy strikes the annual Trans-Pac race from California to Hawaii, bringing Steve McGarrett and his Five-O agents onto the sporty yachting scene in search of a trio of mutineer-murderers.

Gibbs and the team collaborate with an inspector for the International Atomic Energy Agency suffering from radiation poisoning, recreating his routine in an effort to figure out when the contamination took place.

When Ducky and Abby confirm that they have identified the remains of at least five people, the NCIS team immediately begins notifying the families in the hopes of making some connection between the seemingly random selection of victims.
The NCIS team investigates when a marine thought to have frozen to death wakes up on Ducky's autopsy table.

Gibbs and the team investigate when a weekend call to an NCIS tip line results in the death of two agents. The NCIS team discovers a tip about terrorist activity was a trap that resulted in the death of two agents.
